source.method: Live Windows SendInput/MSAA automation + ExtendScript DOM readback

groupChildOrder: ADBE Vector Graphic - Stroke / G-Stroke (Stroke renders on top of Fill)

toolCreatesMaskMode.coordinateSpace: shape_layer_local: (compX - layerPos.x + layerAnchor.x, compY - layerPos.y + layerAnchor.y)

noLayerSelected.singleClickBehavior: creates 1-vertex open ADBE Vector Shape - Group immediately

centerAnchorPrefTrue.vertexCoords: unchanged (relative to initial comp center; layerAnchor shifts to sourceRect center)

nonShapeLayerSelected.rotoBezierProperty: mask.rotoBezier = true when toolbar RotoBezier checkbox checked

shapeLayerSelected.toolCreatesShapeMode: inserts ADBE Vector Group ('形状 1') at index 1 of Contents with groupPosition=[0,0]
shapeLayerSelected.toolCreatesMaskMode: adds ADBE Mask Atom in shape layer local coordinates

bezierRules.altDragMidDrag: freezes inTangent at pre-Alt value and updates only outTangent

typeTool.insertIndexRule: if any layer selected: directly ABOVE topmost selected layer (selectedIndex); else: index 1 (top of comp)

rectEllipseDrag.size: [|x2 - x1|, |y2 - y1|] (always non-negative regardless of drag direction)
rectEllipseDrag.shift: s = max(|dx|, |dy|), anchored at (x1, y1), preserves drag quadrant signs
rectEllipseDrag.ctrl_win_cmd_mac: draw from center (x1, y1): size = [2*|dx|, 2*|dy|], center = (x1, y1)
rectEllipseDrag.alt: does NOT draw from center; behaves like plain drag
rectEllipseDrag.shift_plus_ctrl: square/circle from center (x1, y1): s = 2 * max(|dx|, |dy|)
rectEllipseDrag.space_mid_drag: pans center by (+spaceDx, +spaceDy) without altering size
rectEllipseDrag.doubleClickToolIcon: size = [comp.width, comp.height] (or [layer.width, layer.height] for mask), groupPosition = [0, 0]
rectEllipseDrag.bezierRoundedRectVerticesCCW: 8 vertices around rounded corners, corner tangentLen = r * kappa

polystarDrag.upDownArrow: +1 / -1 point (persists across drags; double-click resets to 5)
polystarDrag.doubleClickToolIcon: outerRadius = min(w, h) / 2, innerRadius = 0.5 * outerRadius (Star) or 50 (Polygon unused), rotation = 0, points = 5, groupPosition = [0, 0]
